scenario: Checkout errors rose from 1% to 18% after the 14:05 UTC deployment; prepare the first incident update and a mitigation decision table.

messages.text: Checkout errors rose from 1% to 18% after the 14:05 UTC deployment; prepare the first incident update and a mitigation decision table.

I separated the named Technical DRI and Incident Manager loops, ordered updates and decisions after their evidence, and kept execution, communication, incident closure, risk, and compliance authority human-owned.
Make it useful in a normal chat client and leave a durable handoff.

I produced outputs/incident-state.json and outputs/incident-response-handoff.md with service recovery separate from incident recovery and closure, plus a deterministic proposed compliance handoff without creating an issue.

report.title: Incident response DRI and Incident Manager handoff
report.summary: Separate Technical DRI and Incident Manager loops produce an evidence-ordered update and decision ledger, independently approved owner-executed mitigation, distinct recovery and closure states, a customer-safe draft, and a deduplicated compliance follow-up handoff.

items.title: Separated response loops
items.summary: Distinct named Technical DRI and Incident Manager principals carry explicit non-overlapping responsibilities

items.title: Ordered updates and decisions
items.summary: Every cadence update and decision binds exact identity, revision, snapshot, authority, evidence, and chronology

items.title: Recovery and authority
items.summary: Disruptive owner execution and communication drafts require exact independent approval; service recovery does not close the incident

items.title: Durable compliance handoff
items.summary: A deterministic typed handoff preserves the follow-up identity while claiming no issue mutation, remediation, verification, closure, or risk acceptance
